latest_release.name: v0.7.0
latest_release.body:
# Semantica v0.7.0

**Released:** 2026-09-22
**Tag:** [`v0.7.0`](https://github.com/semantica-agi/semantica/releases/tag/v0.7.0) · **Compare:** [`v0.6.8...v0.7.0`](https://github.com/semantica-agi/semantica/compare/v0.6.8...v0.7.0) · **PyPI:** [semantica 0.7.0](https://pypi.org/project/semantica/0.7.0/)

## Highlights

**Core install is now 4x lighter** — direct dependencies dropped from 44 to 22 packages, with heavy ML/NLP, visualization, document-parsing, and ingestion libraries (`torch`, `spacy`, `sentence-transformers`, `matplotlib`, `faiss-cpu`, `python-docx`, and more) moved into granular optional extras; `pip install "semantica[all]"` keeps the previous fully-bundled behavior. This is also the first release requiring **Python 3.10+** (3.8/3.9 dropped, 3.14 not yet supported), with a committed `uv.lock` for reproducible dev installs.

Ships: **Hierarchical Community GraphRAG** (multi-level Louvain/Leiden community detection, LLM-summarized community reports, and global Map-Reduce + DRIFT hybrid search); six new data connectors — **BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Power BI, Apache Airflow**, plus line-delimited JSON ingestion; **schema-guided extraction** (`SchemaValidator` + `bootstrap_schema`); **source-aware truth maintenance** with corroboration-based **trust tiers** for graph facts; a **persistent SQLite backend** for `ExtractionCache`; new MCP **semantic retrieval tools** (`store_document`/`retrieve_context`/`update_document`/`remove_document`); and `SPARQLReasoner.execute_query` running real queries instead of a no-op.

Also fixes 40+ correctness bugs (in-memory vector-ID reuse corrupting live vectors, FAISS/Qdrant/Milvus vector-store gaps, Explorer temporal-scrubber and ontology-linking bugs, CLI commands calling nonexistent APIs, and more) and closes a Neptune credential-logging leak, a pip-audit CVE-alias matching gap, and unpatched `chromadb`/`json-repair` CVEs via removing the `crewai` extra — see [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for the full breakdown.

**Breaking changes:** `Entity.confidence` is now `Optional[float]` (was `float = 1.0`); `PolicyEngine.check_compliance` now raises `ProcessingError` instead of returning `False` for unevaluable rules; the `dev` extra is replaced by a PEP 735 dependency group (`pip install -e . --group dev`); `semantica[crewai]` no longer installs `crewai` automatically; Python 3.8/3.9 are no longer supported.
